Query: SELECT c.id, c.name, c.hubspot_id, ( select count(distinct u.id) from users u inner join user_roles ur on ur.user_id = u.id inner join user_rol_company_modules urcm on urcm.user_role_id = ur.id inner join companies_modules cm on cm.id = urcm.companies_modules_id where u.company_id = c.id and u.status_id = 1 and ur.active = 1 and urcm.active = 1 and cm.active = 1 and cm.modules_id = 3 and ur.role_id in (3, 4) ) AS USUARIOS_SOCIAL FROM companies c WHERE c.is_demo = 0 AND c.active = 1 and c.name not like '%QA%' and c.name not like '%Demo%' and c.name not like '%Ronald%' and c.hubspot_id != '' GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.hubspot_id order by c.name;
